scope: Offline GBox keystore branch review combined with a read-only device configuration summary from the sole phone operator; no keybox content is collected.

configurationObservation.matching: Comma split followed by exact package Set.contains; no whitespace trimming.
configurationObservation.limitation: This is the operator-reported whitelist summary. Raw preference data was not retained in this report; current process b4 fields were not read.

rules.staticWriterSearch: Across this decoded sample, b4.d is the only Smali writer to the mask, with two call sites in client.k.s0; no other Smali mask writer was found.

derivedMasksForNormalInitialization.confidence: Derived from verified static defaults plus observed configuration; not a direct read of a running process.

order: If bit 2 is set, pass the returned chain to y0.i
certificateChainDispatch.bit1ForGms: Throws UnsupportedOperationException only when the stored virtual process name is com.google.android.gms.unstable and a current Java stack class name contains droidguard, ignoring case.
certificateChainDispatch.bit2: Routes certificate/chain results through y0.f/y0.i only after prior blocking checks and delegate calls allow it.
certificateChainDispatch.mask3: For GMS unstable with a DroidGuard stack, bit 1 throws before bit 2 can reach y0.i.
certificateChainDispatch.singleCertificateDifference: engineGetCertificate checks bit 2; the bit 1 chain blocker is specific to engineGetCertificateChain.

initializationAndUpdates.configurationRead: BaseMainApplication.attachBaseContext reads common_config and builds ad.a; remote entries are added to built-in sets.
initializationAndUpdates.u0Initialization: SDK i initializes u0 from ad.a once. u0.e returns after its Context has already been set, so a later preference update does not itself refresh an existing process.
initializationAndUpdates.guestInitialization: client.k.s0 processes rule 5 first, calling b4.b then OR 2; rule 3 next calls b4.b then OR 1.
initializationAndUpdates.providerInstall: b4.b records guest PackageInfo and process name, captures the current AndroidKeyStore SPI, and attempts provider replacement. Successful installation sets a guard against repeated replacement.
initializationAndUpdates.maskVersusProvider: A nonzero mask alone is not a direct observation of provider installation or a certificate-chain query.
initializationAndUpdates.remoteSource: Config manager c0 builds a ConfigRequest, obtains CommonConfig through the HTTP client, serializes it to gbox_sp/common_config and uses the response newVersion for cache bookkeeping.
initializationAndUpdates.chainSource: ad.a has a built-in chain string; a nonempty validated gbox_sp/attest_chain can replace it before u0 initialization. No chain or key content was printed or copied.

conclusion.supported: For the reviewed sample under the observed configuration, GMS, Play and MGC do not select the bit 2 to y0 certificate-rewriting route. This route is not a supported explanation for the observed 411-character token-length difference.
conclusion.remainingQuestion: Which provider and process conditions the successful DroidGuard execution actually used; the mask analysis does not determine the microG provider behavior or Google verdict.

result.limitations: Absence of blocker events does not prove certificate chain access.

crossBlockerOff.decision: Do not continue the blocker-toggle-only remedy: the one changed preference altered the observed VM output size but did not improve the Claude token length or login result.
crossBlockerOff.scope: Same GBox MG in the integration2 Cross host; this is a new request, not the earlier official-microG/0.0.4 experiment. No direct provider/SPI or certificate-chain read was made in this run.
